svg.text: #589 Enterprise Embedding & Reranker Serving: TEI/Infinity Unpadded Packing on L40S & MRL INT8
Cloud & AI Solution Architect Guide · 4.28x Faster Top-50 Rerank (14.5ms vs. 62ms) via cu_seqlens · 8.0x Smaller Vector DB RAM (80GB vs. 640GB)
1. Why TEI/Infinity Unpadded Packing Runs 4.28x Faster
✕ Naive PyTorch Rectangular Padding (Top-50 Rerank Batch)
• Pads all 50 candidate chunks to max_len = 512 → 25,600 tokens processed
• 56.2% of Tensor Core FLOPs wasted on [PAD] tokens · P95 Latency: 62.0ms
✓ HuggingFace TEI / Infinity FlashAttention cu_seqlens Packing
• Concatenates 50 variable-length chunks into ONE 1D 11,200-token tensor (0% PAD!)
• Top-50 Cross-Encoder Rerank P95 Latency drops from 62.0ms to 14.5ms (4.28x faster)
• Why L40S Beats H100 by 2.15x on Perf/$: Encoder passes are Compute-Bound (not HBM
bandwidth-bound); L40S ($950/mo) delivers 110 Rerank-QPS vs. 125 QPS on H100 ($2,300/mo)
• 2× L40S ($1,900/mo) serves 200 QPS Query Embed + Top-50 Rerank (-91.4% vs. Managed APIs)
2. Vector DB HNSW Memory Compression (100M Vectors)
A. Uncompressed 1024d FP32 HNSW Index (100M Chunks)
• Raw Vector: 4,096 B × 1.56x HNSW Graph = 640 GB RAM → $3,840/mo Vector DB cluster
• NDCG@10 with Top-50 Reranker: 94.8%
B. Matryoshka MRL 512d + Scalar INT8 Quantization (8.0x Compression)
• Truncate 1024d → 512d (MRL) + SQ8 INT8 = 512 B/vec → 80 GB HNSW RAM ($480/mo, -87.5%!)
• Two-Stage Pipeline: Recall Top-50 via 512d INT8 → Rerank Top-5 via FP16 Cross-Encoder
• Final NDCG@10: 94.5% (Retains 99.7% of uncompressed FP32 quality at 1/8th RAM!)
C. Binary Quantization (1-bit BQ + DiskANN Oversampling 4x)
• 32x RAM compression (20 GB for 100M vectors) · Rescore Top-200 FP16 from NVMe SSD
• Best for billion-scale (1B+) archival search where RAM is the dominant cost
3. End-to-End Retrieval Tier TCO (200 QPS · 100M Vectors)
• Managed Rerank API ($1.00/1K searches @ 200 QPS = $518k/mo) + 640GB FP32 Vector DB ($3.84k/mo) = $521,840/mo.
• Self-Hosted 2× L40S TEI/Infinity ($1,900/mo) + 80GB MRL-512d INT8 Vector DB ($480/mo) = $2,380/mo (-99.5% TCO!).
